anomalies.observed: On the DISPLAY sheet the SSD1306 interface-select pins BS0 (pin 10), BS1 (pin 11) and BS2 (pin 12) of U4 are wired to the VCC/GND symbols in a pattern that does not correspond to BS2,BS1,BS0 = 0,1,0 (BS0 appears tied to VCC rather than GND).
anomalies.expected: BS0 -> GND, BS1 -> VCC, BS2 -> GND (BS2,BS1,BS0 = 0,1,0), the SSD1306's documented I2C-mode pin configuration.

evidence.quote: `BS0` (pin 10) -> GND; `BS1` (pin 11) -> VCC; `BS2` (pin 12) -> GND ... That BS2,BS1,BS0 = 0,1,0 strapping ... is the SSD1306's documented I2C-mode pin configuration.
display.kicad_sch: U4 BS0/BS1/BS2 (pins 10/11/12) wired to the VCC and GND symbols near the top-right of U4

anomalies.impact: The display controller is placed in a non-I2C (SPI/parallel) interface mode, so the 2-wire DISP_SCL/DISP_SDA bus cannot communicate with it and the OLED would remain blank.

parsed.summary: All component values, types and the documented NFC/display/touch connections match the specification, but the SSD1306 interface-select strapping on the display sheet does not appear to match the specified I2C configuration (BS2,BS1,BS0 = 0,1,0), which would put the display driver into the wrong interface mode.
